title: Restricted integrals of continuous unit forms are bounded by the mass of the restriction current
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, μ a Borel measure on ℝ^P, v : ℝ^P → NVector (Eucl P) k with x ↦ v(x)(ω(x)) μ-integrable for every ω ∈ D^k(U), μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U and |v(x)(α)| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α for all x, α. Let A ⊆ ℝ^P and S ∈ D_k(U) with S(ω) = ∫_A v(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x) for all ω ∈ D^k(U), W ⊆ U open, and φ : ℝ^P → Covector (Eucl P) k continuous with compact support, tsupport φ ⊆ W and covectorEuclideanNorm(φ(x)) ≤ 1 for all x. Then ENNReal.ofReal(∫_A v(x)(φ(x)) dμ(x)) ≤ M_W(S).
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (v : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) k), (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, Integrable (fun x => v x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x)) μ) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → (∀ (x : Eucl P) (α : Covector (Eucl P) k), |v x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → ∀ (A : Set (Eucl P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U k), (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, S ω = ∫ x in A, v x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x) ∂μ) → ∀ W : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → ∀ φ : Eucl P → Covector (Eucl P) k, Continuous φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ W → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (φ x) ≤ 1) → ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x in A, v x (φ x) ∂μ) ≤ S.massOn W
